name_input: INDORE GEL; INDORE GEL PVT. LTD
note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of research date. Tooling limitation: the DuckDuckGo/searx search backend returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt, Google returned only a redirect/consent stub, and Bing returned unrelated bot-noise results (credit-union and browser-download pages) for all queries including exact-phrase and site: queries. Zaubacorp returned HTTP 403. Therefore sanctions screening (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS Entity List), Indian court records, regulator actions, negative news, credit rating and Russia/CIS supply evidence could NOT be verified for this entity. Only one usable source was reached: Indian Kanoon. Exact-phrase search for "Indore Gel" on indiankanoon.org returned 'No matching results' (https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=%22Indore%20Gel%22), and the unquoted search returned 101 unrelated hits where 'gel'/'Indore' appear as ordinary words (e.g. 'the case also gels', Indore Development Authority, Indore Bench ITAT) - none of which name a party called Indore Gel. So: no court case naming this company was found in Indian Kanoon, but this is a single-source negative and NOT a clean bill of health. No sanctions listing was found, but no sanctions list was actually queried successfully - do not treat null as 'clear'. No credit rating found; no rating agency page located. No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS found; equally, no evidence of any kind about this company's trade was retrievable. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground and no verdict on rejection is implied here - this is a research-gap flag, not a risk finding. Recommend re-running the sanctions/court/news checks when the search backend is restored, and cross-checking MCA master data and the OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS consolidated lists directly by legal name before any decision. All fields left null because nothing was publicly confirmed; no numbers, CINs, PANs or records were invented.
